legal.draft: Draft. Counsel will replace this text before Siteline launches.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: Siteline is responsible for personal data in the service. The businesses using Siteline are responsible for what they add about their clients.

what.title: What we hold
what.body: Names, mobile numbers or emails, photos and text in project feeds, decisions with their times, and when you last opened a project.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body: Everything is stored in the EU, in Google Cloud's region in Finland. Voice recordings are processed in the EU.

why.title: Why we hold it
why.body: To show you your projects, send the messages you chose and keep decisions on record. We measure how the service is used with our own statistics, with no third-party trackers.

how_long.title: How long
how_long.body: Voice recordings are deleted 30 days after their update is posted. Projects stay as long as the business keeps them, and deleted projects' files go within 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can get a copy of your data, correct it or ask us to delete it. Contact us or the business you use.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact details will be added before launch.

service.title: The service
service.body: Siteline is a service where businesses share updates, questions and decisions with their clients.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Each business decides which staff and clients have access. Links sent to clients should be treated like passwords.

content.title: Content
content.body: You own what you post. You allow us to store it and show it to the people who have access to the project.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Paid plans and their terms will be added when payments arrive.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We do our best to keep the service working, but aren't responsible for agreements between businesses and their clients.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We give notice of changes to these terms in good time.
